changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trades ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, trade_ref VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, instrument_id BIGINT NOT NULL, counterparty_id BIGINT NOT NULL, asset_class VARCHAR(100), side VARCHAR(10), quantity NUMERIC(18,2), price NUMERIC(18,4), trade_date DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(50), deleted_at TIMESTAMP NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_trades_trade_ref UNIQUE (trade_ref, trade_date), CONSTRAINT fk_trades_instrument FOREIGN KEY (instrument_id) REFERENCES instruments(id), CONSTRAINT fk_trades_counterparty FOREIGN KEY (counterparty_id) REFERENCES counterparties(id) ) PARTITION BY RANGE(trade_date);

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS trades CASCADE;
